{{Quote|I will take what Jedi we have left and go to Geonosis and help Obi-Wan.|Mace Windu|audio=Windu-WhatJedi.flac|<ref name="Episode II" />}}
'''Sar Labooda''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] from the [[planet]] [[Chalacta]] who was orphaned by space [[pirate]]s. She and her sister [[Depa Billaba]] were then rescued by the [[Jedi]] [[Mace Windu]] and joined the [[Jedi Order]] on the planet [[Coruscant]]. In [[22 BBY]], Labooda was part of the [[Jedi assault team]] led by Windu to the planet [[Geonosis]] in an effort to rescue [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Labooda infiltrated the [[Petranaki Arena]] where Kenobi was being held and [[First Battle of Geonosis|confronted]] the Separatist forces alongside the other Jedi, but was [[Death|killed]] during the fighting. Labooda's death deeply effected Billaba and contributed to her retreat into [[meditation]].

==Biography==
Sar Labooda<ref name="CGttSWG" /> was a [[Chalactan]]<ref name="Women of the Galaxy" /> [[human]] [[Gender|female]]<ref name="Episode II" /> from the<ref name="Women of the Galaxy" /> [[planet]]<ref name="Kanan">''[[The Secret Jedi: The Adventures of Kanan Jarrus: Rebel Leader]]''</ref> [[Chalacta]].<ref name="Women of the Galaxy" /> She and her sister, [[Depa Billaba]],<ref name="CGttSWG" /> were orphaned by space [[pirate]]s when Billaba was just a girl, but the pair were rescued from their [[homeworld]] by the [[Jedi]] [[Mace Windu]]. Windu took the sisters to the planet [[Coruscant]], where they both found a home at the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] and became members of the [[Jedi Order]],<ref name="Women of the Galaxy" /> the guardians of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Billaba became Windu's [[Padawan]]<ref name="CGttSWG" /> and by<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[32 BBY]],<ref name="TPMDate">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}} to [[32 BBY]].</ref> had achieved the rank of [[Jedi Master]] and earned a seat on the [[Jedi High Council]].<ref name="Women of the Galaxy" />

[[File:SarLaboodaVsBattleDroids-AOTC.png|thumb|left|250px|Labooda confronts [[battle droid]]s on Geonosis.]]
During the [[Separatist Crisis]]<ref name="Episode II" /> in [[22 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Labooda was part of<ref name="Episode II" /> a 212 Jedi<ref name="CVD">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary, New Edition]]''</ref> [[Jedi assault team|assault team]] led by Windu to the planet [[Geonosis]] in order to rescue [[Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Kenobi had been captured while spying on the [[Executive Separatist Council|leaders]] of the newly formed [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and was sentenced to be [[Death|executed]] alongside his Padawan [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] in the [[Geonosian]]<ref name="Episode II" /> [[Petranaki Arena]].<ref name="CGttSWG" />

After Kenobi, Skywalker, and Amidala fended off a trio of arena beasts, Separatist [[battle droid]]s were deployed to the arena to execute them. However, before the [[droid]]s could kill the trio, Windu and the other Jedi revealed their presence, having infiltrated the stands of the the arena. As [[First Battle of Geonosis|fighting]] broke out between the droids and the Jedi on the arena floor, Labooda leapt from a doorway and fought back to back with another Jedi on a walkway in the stands, cutting down [[3464]] and another [[B1-series battle droid]] that had begun firing on her.<ref name="Episode II" /> Although the Republic were ultimately victorious on Geonosis, Labooda perished during the fighting.<ref name="CGttSWG" /> Labooda's death, along with the onset of the [[Clone Wars]] following the battle and Dooku's defection to the Separatists, all effected Billaba deeply, and she retreated into [[meditation]] until the last [[Standard month|months]] of the war.<ref name="HC">{{HelmetCollectionCite|5|Databank A-Z}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Sar Labooda was a [[Force-sensitive]] human with [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and tan skin.<ref name="Episode II" />

==Equipment==
Labooda wore dark brown [[Jedi apparel|Jedi robes]] with a brown [[belt]] and brown [[boot]]s. She wielded a [[lightsaber]] with a green blade.<ref name="Episode II" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Depa.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Sar Labooda was initially intended to be Depa Billaba, but ultimately became a separate character.]]
According to the fan website [http://www.aveleyman.com Aveleyman], Sar Labooda was portrayed by [[Emma Howard]]<ref name="Aveleyman">{{WebCite|url=https://www.aveleyman.com/ActorCredit.aspx?ActorID=76978|text=Aveleyman - Emma Howard|work=[http://www.aveleyman.com Aveleyman.com]|archivedate=20181105143540}}</ref> in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]<ref name="Episode II" /> which was released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Years">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> The Jedi battle in the Petranaki Arena scenes were filmed on Stage 3 at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]], between [[August 10]] and [[August 15]], [[2000]].<ref name="Archives">''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes I–III, 1999–2005]]''</ref>

When casting the humanoid Jedi fighters for the arena scene, director [[George Lucas]] wanted to maintain visual continuity with Jedi characters scene in<ref name="Insider 67 Article">{{InsiderCite|67|Ask Lobot|Star Wars Q&A}}</ref> the [[1999]] film<ref name="TPM" /> [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]. As such, Howard's costume included a [[Mark of Illumination]] and the same haircut that Depa Billaba had sported in Episode I; however, as it was clear on screen that the actors cast in [[Wikipedia:Australia|Australia]] were not the same as those in cast in England for the previous film<ref name="Insider 67 Article" />—[[Dipika O'Neill Joti]] in the case of Billaba<ref name="Lightsaber">''[[Star Wars: The Lightsaber Collection]]''</ref>—it was decided that the Episode II Jedi would become new characters instead, leading to the creation of Sar Labooda.<ref name="Insider 67 Article" />

In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], Labooda's name was first used in the [[2015]] reference book ''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''.<ref name="USWOld">''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]''</ref> In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, Labooda was mentioned prior to the release of ''Attack of the Clones'' in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 55|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #55'']], an<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|regional/1359_1.html|Campaigning Reports from the Mid Rim}}</ref> [[May 10]], 2002<ref name="HNN55 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6774521|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-05-10|time=12:55 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20220611192020/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-14}}</ref> issue published on the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News]] website as part of the marketing for the film.<ref name="HNN" /> The article was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
